fix(postgres): preserve ambiguous Agent lease ownership

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: FWN-51
  description: |-
    Keep the latest generation-bound Agent dispatch as durable runnable-lease ownership across intervening SCM phases. SCM not-applicable Waiting evidence now holds capacity when Agent terminal or containment readback is ambiguous, while proven closure supplies the release authority.
    
    Block SCM-to-Agent handoff when the prior Agent owner is unresolved. When closure is proven, release the old generation before atomically reacquiring and queueing activation with a fresh generation. Add PostgreSQL regressions for SCM Waiting release and downstream Agent rollback, and align the lifecycle documentation.
